title: ExtraOrbital
lede: ExtraOrbital is an open-source CLI that reads a project's .env.example, creates the services it lists and writes working credentials back, so coding agents can set up infrastructure without a human.

points: One command, npx extraorbital provision, detects what the project needs and provisions it.
Covers Postgres, MongoDB, Redis and vector search, plus S3 and R2 storage, auth, realtime and speech-to-text.
AI models are reachable without opening provider accounts or handling their keys.
Agents need no account to use it; humans manage every resource from one dashboard with one monthly invoice and a unified backup.

sections.text: Developers running Claude Code, Codex or several autonomous agents whose work stalls each time someone has to create an account and paste credentials.
The launch comment says it is free to start, with no signup or credit card, and paid resources land on a single monthly invoice.
